name: Mini Three-Cheese English Muffin Pizzas
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 6 large English muffins, split and buttered

steps: Sprinkle buttered muffins with Parmesan cheese.
Toast under broiler until golden brown.
Place 1½ tbsp of shredded cheddar cheese on each muffin.
Cut frankfurters crosswise in ¼-inch slices; arrange on muffins.
Top each with about 2 tbsp of pizza sauce, and sprinkle with 1 tbsp of mozzarella cheese.
Bake 12–15 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

culture.text: Pizza is an Italian dish typically consisting of a flat base of leavened wheat-based dough topped with tomato, cheese, and other ingredients, baked at a high temperature, traditionally in a wood-fired oven.
